analysis.title: Moderna - Raising estimates and PT on model refresh and KOL takeaways
key_insights: PT raised to $200 from $95 after the Ph3 adjuvant melanoma data for intismeran autogene (INT) at ESMO and the Nov 13 Analyst Day. Rating stays Equal-weight with Industry View Attractive. Stock closed at $215.27 on Nov 16, 2026, 7.1% above the new PT.

Changes behind the PT: INT melanoma probability of success (POS) to 100% from 90%, peak penetration for melanoma and NSCLC to 40% from about 30%, profit share to 55% from 50%, and DCF terminal growth to 6% from 4%. Discount rate is 10%.

Unadjusted INT worldwide 2040 sales estimate goes to $32bn from $24bn. Risk-adjusted 2035 INT sales by tumor type: melanoma $5.0bn (40%), NSCLC $4.8bn (37%), RCC $1.3bn (10%), PDAC $1.3bn (10%), bladder $0.3bn (3%).

Next catalyst is the interim analysis of the Ph2 INT RCC (kidney cancer) trial, expected later this year or early 2027. MRNA has not given details on events or powering of the trial and has not decided its disclosure policy if the trial does not unblind at the first interim.

KOL called the Ph3 adjuvant melanoma data groundbreaking, citing the RFS HR of 0.58. In his view an OS benefit is not needed for approval, but effective subsequent therapies could make an OS difference hard to show.

KOL assigns about 60-70% POS to INT in RCC and about 50% in NSCLC. He would not necessarily be discouraged if the RCC trial misses its efficacy threshold at the first interim, because I/O benefit can emerge over time and an effective Keytruda backbone can hide early incremental benefit.

Profit economics: MRNA expects half of profits plus a markup on COGS for its manufacturing role, about 60% in total. MS models 55%. Revenue recognition with partner MRK is still being worked out and INT pricing is not yet known.
COVID franchise COGS assumption cut to 20% from 25-30%, in line with 2026 COGS. Model also updated for the 10-Q.

The new PT implies 4x EV/peak revenue on the INT franchise, versus a historical average of 3x. MS justifies the premium by the difficulty of replicating or genericizing a personalized, algorithm-designed vaccine.

Other KOL points: INT Ph1 adjuvant PDAC poster shows neoantigen-specific T-cell responses in a low-TMB tumor (up to 9 doses, up to 34 neoantigens encoded). He sees a rationale for monotherapy in stage 1 lung cancer, more doubt in bladder (outside his expertise) and in CRC. MS cut bladder POS to 50% from 60% and raised RCC POS to 60% from 50%.
Scenario values: bull $363, base $200, bear $26. Options-implied risk-neutral probabilities as of Nov 16: about 3.4% of exceeding $363, about 28.5% of exceeding $200, about 2.2% of falling below $26.

market_movers.rationale: PT raised to $200 from $95 on higher INT estimates, profit share and terminal growth after Ph3 melanoma data. Stays Equal-weight pending the Ph2 RCC interim analysis.

sector_views.rationale: Morgan Stanley's Industry View for the analyst's biotechnology coverage is Attractive.

earnings_insights: MRNA reported quarterly EPS (actuals shown in the MS table): Q1 2026 $(0.77), Q2 2026 $(1.47), Q3 2026 $0.82. Prior MS Q4 2026e EPS was $(1.47) against a current $0.00. Q4 2027e is $0.00.
MS FY2026e EPS on its consensus methodology is $(2.78), prior $(2.83). FY2027e is $(2.35), prior $(2.98). FY2028e is $1.99, prior $0.92. FY2025 actual was $(4.95).

MS FY2026e estimates vs consensus (Refinitiv): MS revenue $2,102mm vs consensus $2,525mm per the risk-reward grid, EBITDA $(3,470)mm vs $(1,065)mm, net income $(3,857)mm vs $(1,129)mm, EPS $(9.06) vs $(2.78). The extracted layout is ambiguous on which column is MS and which is consensus.
risk_factors: Efficacy or safety concerns could cause investors to write off later readouts across additional modalities.
Delays in Moderna's ability to generate significant clinical data.
The Ph2 RCC interim may not unblind, and MRNA has not set a disclosure policy for that case.
No OS data yet for INT in melanoma, and effective subsequent therapies could make an OS benefit hard to show.
INT pricing and revenue recognition with partner MRK are still undecided.
The stock trades above the new PT, which limits near-term upside in MS's Equal-weight view.

tension_points.bull_case: MRNA is confident in RCC because it is a PD1-sensitive tumor and equivalent efficacy was seen in high and low TMB patients in the Ph2 melanoma study. The KOL assigns about 60-70% POS.
tension_points.bear_case: MRNA has not given powering or event details for the Ph2 trial, and an effective Keytruda backbone could make early incremental benefit hard to show. Some RCC subgroups may not benefit.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A failure to unblind at the first interim, with no disclosure policy set, would leave the RCC question open. The report names the interim analysis, expected later this year or early 2027, as the next input.

theme_stances.key_argument: Melanoma establishes clinical proof of concept for INT and supports further development in other I/O-sensitive tumors.
theme_stances.evidence: Melanoma establishes clinical proof of concept for INT
